tools.name: Clean workflows
tools.summary: Prune completed GitHub Actions runs and optionally remove unused, unprotected branches.
tools.usage: Actions → Clean workflows → Run workflow; enable the separate confirmations for each cleanup.

tools.name: Dataset analysis workflow
tools.summary: Run exploratory analysis on CSV, TSV, JSON, XLSX, or XLS datasets and download a report artifact.
tools.usage: Actions → Dataset analysis → Run workflow; choose a file under data/.

tools.name: Dataset analyzer script
tools.summary: Generate missingness, descriptive statistics, correlations, plots, and optional exploratory OLS results.

tools.name: Archive and image pipeline
tools.summary: Seed, extend, extract, convert, and verify a ZIP archive and image-to-PDF workflow.
tools.usage: python scripts/sandbox_file_pipeline.py --help (requires Pillow for the PDF command).

tools.name: Library file handoff
tools.summary: Stage one file from data/ as a one-day GitHub Actions artifact for transfer into ChatGPT Library.
tools.usage: Actions → Library file handoff → Run workflow; enter a single file path under data/.

tools.name: Tool lookup workflow
tools.summary: Search the compact tool catalog from GitHub Actions and validate its paths.
tools.usage: Actions → Tool lookup → Run workflow; enter a query or leave it blank to list the first five.

tools.name: Tool search script
tools.summary: Search tools by name, purpose, tags, aliases, or path; emits concise text or compact JSON.
